narrative.details:
Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.

Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.
narrative.objectives: Bring the head of Rudolph Gelhardt to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: I don't doubt Danitha's sincerity and desire to earn a place for your kind amongst the Forsaken. However, I suspect that this isn't the last time we'll see one of your brothers and sisters go mad and turn the light against their own people.There may come a time when I decide that tolerating your misbegotten order is no longer in the best interests of the Forsaken. I suggest you continue to serve your people diligently.We will be watching.
narrative.requestItemsText: Why are you addressing me, champion?

mentionedItems.name: Rudolph Gelhardt's Head
tooltip: "A token of loyalty from the paladins of Bandarion Keep. -Danitha Morr"
